summary: This file defines a CardHeader component that renders a styled header div. It takes configuration options for text styling (alignment, weight, decoration, etc.) and merges them into CSS class names using a helper function, then combines those with any custom classes provided by the caller.

explanations.6: Props extends CardTextOptions means this interface includes all the properties from CardTextOptions (like textAlign, variant, italic, etc.) plus adds a few more like className and children.
explanations.21: The equals sign here sets a default value — if the caller doesn't pass italic, it defaults to false automatically.
explanations.27: buildTextClasses is a helper function that takes all the text styling options and converts them into actual CSS class names that can be applied to elements.
explanations.35: We're passing the style configuration options to buildTextClasses along with styles.truncate, which is a reference to a CSS class from the imported stylesheet.
explanations.41: clsx is a utility that combines multiple class names conditionally, filtering out any undefined or false values so we only end up with valid class names.
